## CreditWise LLM — Distribution Repository

This repository (`creditwise-llm`) is the dedicated **distribution repository** for the CreditWise LLM VS Code Extension.
- **Artifacts:** Contains packaged VSIX installation artifacts (`creditwise-llm-vscode-2.4.0.vsix`) and release documentation.
- **Source Code Policy:** Do **NOT** commit any raw source code files (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc.) to this repository. All code development and builds occur in the core development repository.
- **Chat Participant:** In VS Code with the extension installed, invoke `@creditwise` in the Copilot Chat panel to access autonomous model routing, AST context compression, and cost-tier optimization.
